# CodeBuild build execution

**Status: proposed extension.** This service or extension is not implemented in the registered API profiles.
The scope below is a design candidate, without an assigned version or delivery date.

## First useful slice

Extend the implemented project metadata with an explicit build execution/runtime contract.

## Proposed scope

- [ ] `StartBuild`
- [ ] `BatchGetBuilds`
- [ ] `StopBuild`
- [ ] `ListBuilds`
- [ ] `ListBuildsForProject`
- [ ] `BatchDeleteBuilds`
- [ ] Batch builds, workers, source checkout and artifact publication
- [ ] Webhooks, report groups and report generation

## Integration decisions

Project metadata is delivered; build execution must define workers, lifecycle, logs, artifacts, credentials and readiness separately.
